REASON: My choice stands. The task — enumerating differences between American and British English — is a bounded, factual listing request with clear completion criteria, which matches Willet's self-reported top-rated task family (retrieval, extraction, reformatting). Capability evals are effectively tied between the two models on this kind of content (Summarization and Extraction differences are within variance), so the tiebreaker is task-preference fit, which favors Willet.
